app_description.message: 将音量放大至600%，自定义EQ预设，按标签切换输出设备，带有可视化和快捷键。

restore_volume.message: Restore saved volume for this website

save_profile.message: Save current settings for this website

save_speaker.message: Save this speaker for this tab

scroll_adjust_title.message: Allows you to change slider values by scrolling with your mouse wheel.

device_safety_title.message: Automatically lowers volume to a safe level when switching output devices.

help_welcome.message: Welcome to Sound Booster! Enhance your audio experience with powerful controls. Let's get you started with the basics.

help_volume_desc.message: Adjust the volume from 0% to 600% to boost or reduce audio levels for clearer, louder sound.

help_profile_desc.message: Choose from presets like Flat, Voice, Bass, or Treble. Use the save button (✔️) to remember your settings for this site.

help_device_desc.message: Select your preferred speaker or audio device. Volume auto-adjusts for safety when switching; save your choice per tab with the ✔️ button.

device_saved.message: Device preference saved. To change audio output, select the device in your browser's audio settings.

enjoy_message.message: Enjoying Supbyte? Consider leaving a review!
